A '''T-series tactical droid''' was active during the [[Clone Wars]], it was present on the surface of the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]]. It arrived at the aftermath of a short firefight between [[Clone Force 99]] and a group of [[B1-series battle droid]]s, holding a [[hologram]] of [[Admiral]] [[Trench]]. A nearby [[BX-series droid commando]] addressed the hologram, reporting that the [[Clone trooper|clones]] had used unorthodox methods to defeat the droids. After the report, the tactical droid returned to the speeder in which it arrived and left the scene. The droid continued to report the clone troopers' actions during the battle to the [[Harch]].

==Biography==
===Serving Trench===
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events involving [[Ahsoka Tano]] and the Martez sisters on [[Oba Diah]] take place between Tano's [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano|trial]] and departure from the [[Jedi Order]], and the [[Battle of Coruscant]], which takes place concurrently to the [[Siege of Mandalore]] that Tano fought in. Both the trial and the Battle of Coruscant are dated to [[19 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', so "[[Gone with a Trace]]," "[[Deal No Deal]]," "[[Dangerous Debt]]" and "[[Together Again]]" must also take place in that year. {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places "[[The Bad Batch (episode)|The Bad Batch]]," "[[A Distant Echo]]," "[[On the Wings of Keeradaks]]" and "[[Unfinished Business (episode)|Unfinished Business]]" between "Together Again" and "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]," which are both dated to 19 BBY. Hence, the battle and the episode's events take place in 19 BBY.</ref> the tactical droid served under [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]] in the [[Clone Wars]]. He arrived at a crash site of a Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport|Gunship]] on a speeder after a brief skirmish between [[Clone Force 99]] and a group of [[B1-series battle droid]]s.<ref name="The Bad Batch" />

A [[BX-series droid commando]] approached him as the tactical droid talked with Admiral Trench, the commando addresed the hologram, reporting that the clones had used unorthodox strategies to defeat the droids. Later, the tactical droid reported to Trench from an ambushed [[Anaxes Separatist Security Outpost|separatist outpost]], informing the Admiral that a clone strike team had captured the outpost and [[Desertion|deserted]] it,<ref name="The Bad Batch" /> the [[Harch]]<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|admiral-trench|Admiral Trench}}</ref> told him that he saw no tactical value in taking the outpost, however, he informed the droid that the clones' next target would be the [[Cyber Center]], and that he wanted the tactical droid to connect him with the outpost immediately. The tactical droid later reported to Trench after the clones were chased out of the Cyber Center that they had made a connection with the planet [[Skako Minor]] while they were there, which alarmed Trench.<ref name="The Bad Batch" />

===Legacy===
After Trench was informed of the connection with Skako Minor,<ref name="The Bad Batch" /> the Admiral contacted [[Minister]] [[Wat Tambor]], alerting him that the Republic was going to attack the [[Techno Union]]. Although Wat Tambor initially dismissed Trench's warning, he ultimately accepted it and prepared for the clones' arrrival<ref name="Keeradaks">{{TCW|On the Wings of Keeradaks}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The T-series tactical droid appeared in the first episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] TV series' first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|show's seventh season's]] "[[The Bad Batch (episode)|The Bad Batch]]." Which aired on [[February 21]], [[2020]].<ref name="Press Release">{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/new-on-disney-plus-february-2020|text=What's New on Disney Plus February 2020, Including Toy Story 4|author=Gregory Lawrance|archivedate=20200221195811}}</ref>
